english.summary: A fantasy roguelike that turns matching pairs into a game of memory, luck and strategy.
english.caseStudyTitle: Memory and strategy in every pair.
english.description: Created by LuminariaCreations for IndieGG Jam - The Third. Match cards and build scoring synergies through their rarity, affinity and family. Choose upgrades between rounds, then adapt your strategy to bosses that introduce special rules. Play the prototype directly in your browser on itch.io.
english.award: Machanguito Award for Best Game at Indie GG Jam GCX26
